import re, collections
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

def parse(path):
    x=y=z=0.0; obj=-1
    segs=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for line in open(path,errors='replace'):
        line=line.strip()
        if line.startswith('M486'):
            m=re.match(r'M486 S(-?\d+)',line)
            if m: obj=int(m.group(1))
            continue
        if line.startswith(('G0','G1')):
            d={}
            for tok in line.split()[1:]:
                if tok and tok[0] in 'XYZE':
                    try: d[tok[0]]=float(tok[1:])
                    except: pass
            nx=d.get('X',x); ny=d.get('Y',y); nz=d.get('Z',z); ne=d.get('E',0.0)
            if ne>0.00001:
                segs[obj].append((x,y,z,nx,ny,nz,ne))
            x,y,z=nx,ny,nz
    return segs

segs=parse('/app/text.gcode')

def render(obj, zsel, fname, w=1600, pad=10):
    ss=[s for s in segs[obj] if zsel(s[2])]
    xs=[p for s in ss for p in (s[0],s[3])]; ys=[p for s in ss for p in (s[1],s[4])]
    x0,x1=min(xs),max(xs); y0,y1=min(ys),max(ys)
    sc=(w-2*pad)/(x1-x0)
    h=int((y1-y0)*sc)+2*pad
    img=Image.new('L',(w,h),255); dr=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for s in ss:
        def P(px,py): return (pad+(px-x0)*sc, pad+(y1-py)*sc)
        dr.line([P(s[0],s[1]),P(s[3],s[4])], fill=0, width=2)
    img.save(fname)
    print(fname, 'segs',len(ss),'x',x0,x1,'y',y0,y1,'size',img.size)

# object 0 layers
z0=sorted({round(s[2],3) for s in segs[0]})
print('obj0 top z', z0[-3:])
render(0, lambda z: abs(z-z0[-1])<1e-6, '/app/obj0_top.png')
render(0, lambda z: abs(z-z0[-2])<1e-6, '/app/obj0_top2.png')
render(0, lambda z: True, '/app/obj0_all.png')
z1=sorted({round(s[2],3) for s in segs[1]})
render(1, lambda z: abs(z-z1[-1])<1e-6, '/app/obj1_top.png')
EOF
python3 /app/render.py
